Liana graduated from California State University Monterey Bay (CSUMB) with a B.S. in marine science where her research focused on mapping the spatial and temporal distribution of purple sea urchins (*Strongylocentrotus purpuratus*) and giant kelp (*Macrocystis pyrifera*). After graduation, she interned with the Pacific Islands Regional Office (PIRO) for NOAA Fisheries and then worked as an environmental consultant for a project on Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam (JBPHH). She is now conducting research with the Iacchei Lab for the Master of Science in Marine Science (MSMS) program at HPU. Her research will investigate how spiny lobster (ula) populations in Hawai\`i respond to differing ecological and anthropogenic pressures. Liana's goal is to integrate Hawai\`i's cultural practices and customs with protecting marine species and habitats.
